Technology Partners
Strategic technology partnerships that enhance our robot capabilities and expand our ecosystem.
Partners: NVIDIA | AWS (Amazon Web Services) | Qualcomm

NVIDIA — Edge AI Computing partner of Chikku Robotics.
NVIDIA provides the GPU computing platform (Jetson Orin) that powers our Chikku Core ECU and on-device AI inference. We are an NVIDIA Preferred Partner for robotics.
Collaboration: Co-development of optimized AI models for Jetson platform. Early access to next-generation edge AI hardware.

metadata.keywords: partner | partnership | NVIDIA | Edge AI Computing

AWS (Amazon Web Services) — Cloud Infrastructure partner of Chikku Robotics.
AWS hosts our Chikku Cloud fleet management platform. Provides scalable compute, storage, and ML training infrastructure.
Collaboration: AWS Robotics Competency Partner. Joint go-to-market for manufacturing and logistics customers.

metadata.title: Partner: AWS (Amazon Web Services)
metadata.keywords: partner | partnership | AWS (Amazon Web Services) | Cloud Infrastructure

text:
Qualcomm — Wireless & IoT partner of Chikku Robotics.
Qualcomm 5G modules enable ultra-reliable low-latency communication for our autonomous vehicles and remote teleoperation.
Collaboration: 5G-enabled robot connectivity. On-device AI acceleration using Snapdragon platforms.
